verdict.rationale: ROS 2 offers a documented 'ROS-Base (Bare Bones)' install with communication libraries and command-line tools but no GUI tools. The `ros2` CLI lets you script topics, services, nodes and bag record/play, and the launch system coordinates multiple nodes, so headless, scriptable operation is clearly supported. CI use is only implied: nothing in the pack covers CI pipelines, test frameworks or container images. Missing for 10: explicit CI/automated-testing documentation (e.g. launch-based testing, CI integration guides, official containers), independent hands-on corroboration of headless/CI use.
